cost_model_highlights: Base proposal: reserved capacity = 6 x 80GB GPUs (A100-class equiv) with 2-node burst pool; 24/7 baseline for predictable throughput.
Assumptions: 65% baseline utilization for embeddings workload, 40% for chat (higher memory/latency headroom).
Unit economics: amortized infra + license = $0.95 per 1K tokens for baseline commit; with higher 75% utilization target brings to $0.72 per 1K tokens.
Burst pricing: overflow routed to hosted at 1.6x baseline unit cost; auto-fallback policy included in SOW.
Commit tiers: 1-year pure reserved (discount 38%), 3-year locked (discount 52%) — procurement pushing for 3-year but worried about model churn and obsolescence.
SLA asks: 99.95% monthly uptime for dedicated pool, p95 latency target 250ms for chat gen (token streaming), 50ms for embedding vector responses under batch sizes recommended.
Cost sensitivity: customer needs scenario table mapping 30/50/70/90% utilization to $/1M tokens — provided in draft spreadsheet.
Break-even horizon: with current traffic forecast, 1-year reserved hits break-even at ~58% utilization vs. pay-as-you-go; 3-year reduces break-even to ~35%.
Add-ons: extended observability (+$15k/yr), higher retention for audit logs (+$9k/yr), optional canary rollback insurance (+$7k/yr).
technical_requirements: Guaranteed throughput: sustain 150 chat sessions with <=30ms token generation time under baseline load.
Latency SLOs: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 250ms for chat; embeddings median < 40ms when batched at 16.
Model preferences: prefer open Llama-family quantized models for cost, but want Redwood to host a tuned 1.3B and 13B candidate set for A/B rollouts.
Routing policy: primary = Dedicated NA, fallback = Hosted multi-region, policy to prefer EU-hosted nodes for EU-residents' data.
KV cache: customer will provide per-session prefixes; require runtime support for prefix caching and TTL controls.
po_c_plan: 6-week POC: week1 infra + security scoping, week2 model onboarding + perf tuning, week3 load tests, week4 latency tuning, week5 canary with internal beta, week6 handover + runbook.
POC success metrics: p95 latency target met, sustained throughput > 80% of projection, no unresolved security blockers.
Deliverables: performance report, cost model final, SLO appendix for contract.
